user.title: YouTube Download
user.description: Downloads land in Home Assistant's media directories. YouTube links are saved as MP3; image URLs are saved as-is.

data.preferred_folder: Folder to pre-select for YouTube links
data.max_history: Downloads to keep in the card

data_description.preferred_folder: Matched against folder names, case-insensitively. Leave blank to always choose manually.
data_description.max_history: Older finished downloads drop off the list. Nothing is kept across restarts.

download_url.name: Download URL
download_url.description: Download a YouTube video as MP3, or an image, into one of Home Assistant's media folders.

url.name: URL
url.description: A YouTube link, or a direct http(s) URL to an image.

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: Where to save it, inside a configured media directory.

filename.description: Filename without extension. Defaults to the video title or the image URL's last path segment.

list_media_folders.description: Return every folder a download can be filed into, plus the one a YouTube URL pre-selects.
